article.title: Effect of winding up order.
article.content: The order for the winding up of a company shall operate in favour of all the creditors and all contributories of the company as if it had been made out on the joint petition of creditors and contributories.
article.html:
278Effect of winding up order.

Section 278 · Chapter XX · Part I · page 173 of the Act

The order for the winding up of a company shall operate in favour of all the creditors and all contributories of the company as if it had been made out on the joint petition of creditors and contributories.
